notes.title: 🎉🍺 Cheers to 1 Year of Boomerangs & Beers! 🍺🎉
notes.notes:
It's time to get amped for our birthday update! 🗓️

🦘 Get Ready for Hard Mode: Kangaroo Mayhem!
Things are going wild! Hard mode is turning up the kangaroo chaos. Defend your brews from these crazy kangaroos – it's a boomerang showdown like never before!

🌴 Chill Out in Zen Mode: BBQ and Relax!
Need a breather? Zen mode is your jam. Take it easy, cook up some grub for your mates, and practice your boomerang skills on laid-back cardboard kangaroos. It's like target practice, Aussie style.

🎥 Peek at the Fun!
Check out the sneak peek to see what's in store:
[previewyoutube=vDDCzme6vy8;full][/previewyoutube]

And there's more good news! We've slashed the price of the game to just $4.99. Thanks for an incredible year of boomerangs, beers, and roo chaos! Dive into the fun, and here's to another year of thrilling boomerang battles! 🍻

notes.title: Santa Hats and Small fixes - 1.0.2
notes.notes:
This week we added a Santa hat to the baby roos that will stay around until the 28th
We also did some minor fixes on some dodgy colliders' funny letters/accents.

We worked like hell this year, this Christmas we will take it a bit easy. 
Keep an eye out for us in this winter sale! Who knows what Santa brings!

notes.title: Easy mode + New boomerangs - Update
notes.notes:
We are releasing ✨ 1.0.1✨!

[b]Features:[/b]
- Added "easy" mode!! The game was a tad hard, so we made it easier so you can share it with your non-VR-expert friends
- Added a 🧑‍🍳 Spatula and a 🔫 Gun Boomerang as rewards for reaching Wave 20 in the arcade

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Increased time until drinks start warming up from 5 secs to 8 secs
- Updated the game icon
- Added extra clue to how to select a boomerang skin -> put them in your pockets!
- Make boomerangs not flop when touching each other -> Dual throwing is way better now!
- Make "beers lost display" transparent when the player is nearby
- Improve menu buttons so you don't have to aim as much
- If you want to open the game with OVR go to the beta channel, the key is "oculusLoader".

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fix snag and burger bug where the burger keeps on grilling outside of the grill
- Fix tinyroo not being properly grilled when "ragdoll mode" was on

We are going on vacation next week, so no updates (I hope). I will still keep an eye on discord, so do leave suggestions/bug reports.

Have a lovely day 🙂

notes.title: May DevLog - Homerun a Kangaroo
notes.notes:
We made a vlog about our last month of development!

Among other stuff we:
🎮 Rebalanced 2 boss fights
💼 Failed to make a company 😛 But we should nail it soon. "Witty Platypus" is an official studio approved name!
🧐 Did a lot of project management
🅱️ Planed all features and scope until we get a Beta version. We will be on the lookout for beta testers in... Mid of July! Stay tuned
🐛 🕷️ 🦗 Kept on fixing bugs and improving the quality of the game
🏹 Started reworking the campaign mode. Right now the losing conditions were a bit messy, so we will rework a lot of stuff so it's obvious for players what is "winning" and what is "losing"
🍞 Reworked our Slo-mo Spread, Thanks to everyone that voted on discord. It's super satisfying (You can see it in the video!)
🏔️ started working in a port to other platforms!


[previewyoutube=7oNLxUYI3yw;leftthumb]https://youtu.be/7oNLxUYI3yw[/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Added LIV (XR!) integration and improved food grabbing
notes.notes:
There is a lot of minor adjustments, but the big stuff is:

You can stream in XR!
Your hands will no longer get stuck in the plate with the burger
There's a new watch that allows you to restart and quit levels

notes.title: Added Voices to friends and quality of life improvement
notes.notes:
Players were having a hard time understanding why our friends refused their beers and burgers.
Now the friends will complain about why are they not taking any of it!

Also did some bug fixes and improvements in quality of life :)
Level 2 is more balanced and a bit easier
Boomerangs were not making any sound when returning after hitting an enemy
Skin selector no longer require your hand to hover over the aura
Other minor stuff

Thanks Inês and Douglas 'Technal' Bicker for the Voice Acting!

notes.title: Demo adjustments!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The Skin selector was a bit hidden, so we made it pop
[*] Level 1 is a bit more challenging for people who are good at taking care of roos fast (but not harder for people that struggle with it -> programming!)
[*] When you mess up the cooking we now make a sound and tell you who did you mess it up!
[*] You have a watch to know how much time is left so you don't have to find the bird!
[*] Manual height and waist adjustment
[/list]

More quality of life features will come for the full game! worry not

Cheers! 
Diogo and Inês
